title: Bookworms Online
subtitle:
Application security membership login web page focused on IT fundamentals.
-========-
Built with protection against CSRF, XSS, and SQL injection. Includes 2FA (authenticator app + Maileroo email/SMS OTP flow), Google reCAPTCHA v3, encrypted credit-card data handling, and salted + hashed passwords.
